name: Evangelizing
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively share the gospel, making disciples of all nations through teaching, baptizing, and preaching the good news to every creature, empowered by the Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19; Mark 16:15; Acts 1:8). Evangelizing is not optional but a solemn responsibility, as failing to warn the wicked of their danger results in accountability before God (Ezekiel 33:8). Believers are called to let their lives reflect Christ’s truth and light so that others may glorify God (Matthew 5:16), recognizing that Jesus alone is the way to the Father (John 14:6).
